title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures trade flat with Iran and the Fed in focus
title_zh: 今日股市：标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道琼斯指数期货持平，伊朗和美联储成为焦点
summary: The major gauges wavered after strikes in Iran resumed to end a brief period of stability.
summary_zh: 伊朗的罢工恢复结束了短暂的稳定期后，主要指标出现动摇。

title: DeepSeek looks to reduce reliance on Nvidia with own AI chip
title_zh: DeepSeek 希望通过自己的 AI 芯片减少对 Nvidia 的依赖
summary: Yahoo Finance's Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton to examine DeepSeek's development of a custom AI chip to bypass U.S. export restrictions and reduce its reliance on Nvidia.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的 Dan Howley 与 Josh Lipton 一起研究 DeepSeek 开发的定制 AI 芯片，以绕过美国的出口限制并减少对 Nvidia 的依赖。

title: US Chief Design Officer Joe Gebbia breaks down the website creation for Trump Accounts
title_zh: 美国首席设计官乔·杰比亚 (Joe Gebbia) 详细介绍了特朗普账户的网站创建过程
summary: Yahoo Finance's Jennifer Schonberger spoke with the first-ever Chief Design Officer of the United States, Joe Gebbia, highlighting the rollout, engineering process, and early funding milestones of the new "Trump Accounts" savings and trading platform for children.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的 Jennifer Schonberger 与美国首位首席设计官 Joe Gebbia 进行了交谈，重点介绍了新的儿童储蓄和交易平台“特朗普账户”的推出、工程流程和早期融资里程碑。

title: SpaceX to join the Nasdaq 100: How Wall Street feels about the Elon Musk story
title_zh: SpaceX 加入纳斯达克 100 指数：华尔街如何看待埃隆·马斯克的故事
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) will join the Nasdaq 100 (^NDX) on Tuesday after going public via an IPO over 3 weeks ago.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 在三周前通过 IPO 上市后，将于周二加入纳斯达克 100 指数 (^NDX)。

title: Who will be the AI trade's real winners: The makers vs. the takers?
title_zh: 谁将成为人工智能行业的真正赢家：制造者与接受者？
summary: Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) released preliminary second quarter earnings results on Tuesday, reporting a 19-fold profit jump from a year ago, amounting to $58 billion.
summary_zh: 三星电子(005930.KS)周二公布了第二季度初步财报，利润同比增长19倍，达到580亿美元。

title: NYSE president optimistic about forthcoming IPOs, says economy is doing 'extraordinarily well'
title_zh: 纽约证券交易所总裁对即将举行的首次公开募股持乐观态度，称经济表现“非常好”
summary: New York Stock Exchange President Lynn Martin told Yahoo Finance that she feels optimistic about the stock market and the economy as momentum builds for companies going public following a long IPO drought.
summary_zh: 纽约证券交易所总裁林恩·马丁 (Lynn Martin) 告诉雅虎财经，她对股市和经济感到乐观，因为在经历了长期 IPO 荒之后，公司上市的势头正在增强。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq fall as semiconductors sell off, oil prices jump
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数因半导体抛售而下跌，油价上涨
summary: US stocks were mixed on the heels of a record-setting day on Wall Street.
summary_zh: 华尔街创纪录的一天后，美国股市涨跌互现。
